title: Day 1 Give-A-Way $100 Lowe's Gift Card
description: Sponsored by: Jim Wurtenberg of Central Real Estate Inspections - Thanks Jim!

asr.full_text: Hey everyone, Jenna May from the Jenna May team of Keller Williams here, wrapping up. A busy Sunday and I am very excited to announce our first giveaway in our five day of giveaway. For March Madness. The first drawing is for a $100 gift card to Lowe's. Never stop improving, it makes it easier for you on resale. This is sponsored by Jim Wartenberg from Central Real Estate Inspections. Jim, thanks so much for your support. It really means a lot to us. If you are interested in entering into this drawing, make sure you click the link below,. Completely fill out the form. Also, make sure you like this post and our business page. And if you would like an additional five entries into the drawing, make sure that you give. Us a referral before 5 p.m. for your chance for five additional entries. If you have any questions, don't hesitate to reach out to us. And as always, thank you so much for all of your support. Bye.
